lessons.title: Accessible Landmarks & Keyboard Navigation Audit
lessons.introduction: Learn how semantic HTML landmarks enable screen-reader users and keyboard-only visitors to navigate complex interfaces rapidly without visual cues.
objectives: Structure pages using header, nav, main, aside, and footer landmarks
Verify keyboard focus order and skip-navigation ergonomics

blocks.text: Landmark Hierarchy in Modern Web Documents
Using <nav>, <main>, and <article> intentionally gives assistive technology an accurate structural map so users can jump straight to primary content.

blocks.meaning: A programmatically exposed section of a page (such as main, navigation, or banner) derived automatically from native semantic HTML elements.

blocks.title: 5-Minute Keyboard Audit Workflow
items: Press Tab from the address bar and confirm a visible focus indicator on every interactive control.
Verify only one top-level <main> landmark wraps the core page workspace.
Check that focus order matches top-to-bottom visual reading flow.

blocks.title: Avoid Redundant Roles
blocks.text: Native <main> already exposes role=main; only add aria-label when distinguishing multiple <nav> landmarks on the same page.

blocks.prompt: Which HTML element should wrap the unique central content of a page?
blocks.explanation: A single <main> landmark lets screen readers skip repeated navigation and jump straight to primary content.

videos.title: Keyboard Focus & Landmark Inspection Walkthrough
videos.viewingInstructions: Watch how the accessibility tree updates as native landmarks replace generic containers.
videos.transcript: Screen reader landmark menus list banner, navigation, main, and contentinfo regions automatically.

lessons.summary: Consistent semantic landmarks reduce navigation friction and eliminate fragile manual focus overrides.
takeaways: Prefer native HTML5 landmark tags over generic div containers.
Label multiple navigation landmarks uniquely with aria-label.
lessons.completionCriteria: Audit a multi-section layout with keyboard navigation and complete the inline landmark check.
